name: Relaxing Places
summary:
Start on the sand at Saltwind Cove. Follow a wave as it breaks beside the sea arch, or turn toward the palms and see how close you can get to a ghost crab before it slips into its burrow.

Open Places whenever you want a change of scenery. Walk the shore of Alpine Mirror and watch the snowy peaks shift in the lake’s reflection. Follow a creek through the old cedars of Cedar Hollow. On the terrace at Night Observatory, look up from the lanterns to find the aurora above the clouds.
